title.narrative: Investing for impact against Tuberculosis and HIV - South Africa (01-Apr-2019-31-Mar-2022)

description.narrative: South Africa, TB/HIV, Networking HIV and AIDS Community of Southern Africa NPC (NACOSA)This program has the following goals: Accelerate prevention to reduce new HIV and TB infections and STIs. Reduce morbidity and mortality by providing treatment, care and adherence support for all. Reach all key and vulnerable populations with customised and targeted interventions. Address the social and structural drivers of HIV, TB and STIs, and lin these effort to the National Development Plan. Ground the response to HIV, TB and STIs in human rights principles and approaches. Promote leadership and shared accountability for sustainable response to HIV, TB and STIs. Mobilise resources and maximise efficiencies to support the achievment of NSP goals and ensure a sustainable approach. Strengthen strategic information to drive progress towards achievement of NSP goals. The objectives of this program are: 1.1 Reduce new HIV infections to less than 100,000 by 2022 through combination prevention interventions. 2.1 Implement the 90-90-90 strategy for HIV. 2.2 Implement the 90-90-90 Strategy for TB. 3.1 Increase engagment, collaboration and advocacy of key and vulnerable populations in the development and implementation of social and health support activities. 3.2 To provide an enabling environment to increase access to health services by key and vulnerable populations. 4.1 Implement social and behaviour change programmes to address key drivers of the epidemic and build social cohesion. 4.4 Implement and scale up a package of harm reduction interventions for harmful use of alcohol and drugs in all districts. 4.5 Implement economic strengthening programmes with a focus on youth in priority focus districts. 5.3 Promote an environment that enables and protects human and legal rights and prevents stigma and discrimination. 6.1 Strengthen AIDS Councils to provide effective co-ordination and leadership of all stakeholders for shared accountability in the implementation of the NSP. 7.1 Improve efficiency and mobilise sufficient resources to achieve the goals, objective and targets of the NSP. 8.1 Optimise routinely collected strategic health information for data utilisation in decision making
